message.content:
I need screens and buttons that let me:

- See which drones are out of service for repairs and which are ready to fly.
- Check the status of charging pads at each site and send drones to charge.
- Add new drones to the fleet and retire old ones.
- Track which drones are at which sites and which jobs they’re assigned to.
- Get alerts when drones restart in flight or when charging issues occur.

I also need to be able to update the system while drones are flying, since it’s often restarted during working hours.
